mentions.name: GitSocial
mentions.description: A self-hosted code collaboration platform that keeps everything in git: issues, pull requests, comments, releases, and more. It aims to be a viable self-hosted alternative to GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on https://gitsocial.org/ for a year and a half now. The approach is to keep it all in git: issues, PRs, comments, releases, etc.

Hoping it becomes a viable self-hosted alternative to GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg!

mentions.name: GitSocial
mentions.description: GitSocial is a decentralized, open source social network built entirely on Git. It works as a tool that can turn any repository into a blog or social network in place.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on GitSocial - decentralized open source social network built entirely on Git.

https://gitsocial.org/

Think of it as tool that can turn any repository into a blog/social network in place.
